verdict.rationale: Cloudflare publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at developers.cloudflare.com/openapi.json, and its Code Mode MCP server lets an agent search() and execute() calls against the full API of 2,500+ endpoints. That gives an AI-native user an explorable, executable path through the API. However, nothing in the evidence shows a human-facing interactive API reference with runnable "try it" examples; the closest are static copy-paste snippets such as `npm create cloudflare` and `wrangler d1 create`. Missing for 10: a documented interactive API reference UI, runnable in-page examples or a sandboxed playground, and hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
